title: Private Sagrada Familia
text: Unbelievable experience with Cataerin. Extremely knowledgeable and dedicated to ensuring we have a great time. Please book with her.
author: Exploration792794

title: Excellent Tour and Communication
text:
We booked a private Sagrada Família tour with LivTours, and I especially appreciated their communication before our tour. I had let them know that we were traveling with my elderly parents, and they were very reassuring about accommodating their pace. They also contacted me when they weren't able to secure tower tickets at a convenient time and promptly refunded that portion of our booking. We wound up purchasing tower tickets on our own, and the timing worked out just fine.

Our guide, Carla, met us right on time in front of the KFC and immediately adjusted to our group's pace. We walked slow
author: mauinoel

title: Excellent
text: Nuria was an excellent guide. She was engaging, passionate and very well versed in her subject matter. I would definitely recommend this tour, especially if you're lucky enough to get Nuria as your guide. Excellent!
author: J1772ZNkarens

title: SAGRADA FAMÍLIA PRIVATE TOUR WITH HELENA: MIND BLOWING!
text: Helena was EXCELLENT!  What an amazing experience at the Sagrda Famila!  She was so personable, professional and had a wealth of knowledge.  We were in. Barcelona a few days earlier than our cruise left to learn more about this beautiful city.  The private tour was worth every euro! If you want a personalize, warm, friendly time, book Helena.  She will not disappointe you.
author: 411jenniferL

title: Great guide for Sagrada Familia
text: Caterina was very knowledgeable, moved at a good pace and was very friendly. We enjoyed our time with her immensely.  The tour itself was very expensive even for a private tour.
author: hepalien98008

title: Amazing Sagrada Familia Guide and Tour
text: Valentina was a fantastic guide for our early tour of Sagrada Familia! Her passion for the subject comes through with how knowledgeable she is about the massive cathedral. She was incredibly sweet and understanding with our two kiddos that were carsick and sleep-deprived. We would absolutely book with Liv tours again, and Valentina would be our absolute request for another guide!
author: X3928UFlauriec

title: ​The Best Way to See La Sagrada Familia
text: Giovanna was an excellent guide for La Sagrada Familia! She was punctual, highly knowledgeable, and had a great route planned. She managed the heavy crowds flawlessly to get us the best views and took wonderful photos of our group. Highly recommend requesting her if you want an amazing experience!
author: dgfoley

title: Wonderful tour with Carla
text: I'm so grateful for this tour option. I traveled with my mom, baby and husband and it was the perfect tour length for a toddler before meltdown set in. Carla was very informative and personable throughout the tour. She was at the check in point before we got there and made us feel very welcomed to Barcelona. She provided great insight to allow us to appreciate the amazing La Salgrada Familia and Gaudi. The early tour means skipping lots of the crowds and being able to appreciate the views more. We also got some great recommendations on what to explore next with our day. Overall a wonderful exp
author: Jennifer C

title: Superb private tour of Sagrada familia
text: Superb tour. Fantastic guide.  Valentina was a great guide, very knowledgeable, knew the background of Sagrada familia and provided excellent anecdotes and other material during the tour. Highly recommend LIV Tours and Valentina as a guide
author: jeffbW7120CY

title: Worth the earlier start!
text: Giovanna was amazing, brought everything to life, all the symbolism, the history and made our visit so enjoyably educational! We really felt we experienced the place properly! Throughly recommended!
